races.race_name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse "Hands And Heels" Apprentice Classified Stakes (RE Series)

runners.name: Charencey
runners.spotlight: Over two years since the last of his three wins; yet to shine in 2026 but he drops into a 0-50 classified for the first time and he can't be discounted.
runners.comment: On a losing run but drops into his first 0-50 classified; could revive but not solid

runners.name: Myna
runners.spotlight: Two 1m2f wins this year, the latest a fast-ground handicap at Leicester in May; respectable efforts since without hitting quite the same heights; should give a good account.
runners.comment: Two 1m2f wins this year, the latest on fast turf in May; should be involved again

runners.name: Nymphaea
runners.spotlight: Scrambled home in a 1m6f handicap here (good to firm) last month; no threat in an Epsom handicap since; drops in trip and wouldn't want this to become tactical.
runners.comment: Narrow 1m6f win here last month; no threat in a handicap last time; drop in trip a query

runners.name: Spaceage Love Song
runners.spotlight: Comfortable win in a similar event at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in February; runner-up in Yarmouth events (1m2f/extended 1m3f) twice this month; another big run expected.
runners.comment: 1m4f win at this level in February; runner-up twice at Yarmouth this month; solid claims
runners.owner: M L W Bell Racing Ltd

runners.name: Hello Garda
runners.spotlight: Second of six, beaten over 3l, in a similar event at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) last month; modest hurdle form nine days ago; not fully exposed on the Flat.
runners.comment: Second in a similar event at Chepstow last month; still capable of better on the Flat

runners.name: Arc At Her
runners.spotlight: Modest form in maiden/novice company at up to 8.6f; tailed off in a 1m2f handicap at Leicester 17 days ago; drops in grade with cheekpieces added but plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Poor form in four starts, tailed off on handicap debut latest; now tries cheekpieces
runners.owner: Gee Gee's Racing & Hold My Beer

races.race_name: EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Remi Mae
runners.spotlight: She has been consistent rather than progressive in novice events; return to sprinting should suit and she holds place claims once again.
runners.comment: Consistent rather than progressive; return to sprinting a plus; each-way claims

runners.name: Too Too Divine
runners.spotlight: She has improved her RPR with each of her three starts, all over 7f, keeping on for third at Yarmouth six weeks ago; drop in trip a slight niggle but she's open to further progress.
runners.comment: All runs over 7f, improving her RPR with each start, and still capable of better

runners.name: March Of Time
runners.spotlight: Well-related filly who fared best of the newcomers, behind a long odds-on favourite, on her Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) early last month; reared as the stalls opened when fourth of five at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) ten days ago; now tried in a hood; capable of better.
runners.comment: Didn't build on debut promise last time (reared start); now hooded; still has potential

runners.name: Honky Tonk Girl
runners.spotlight: Her debut run at Bath (5.7f, good) was encouraging but she hasn't kicked on in two subsequent runs (both on AW), the latest at Wolverhampton (6f) last week; needs more.
runners.comment: Not built on Bath debut promise in two AW runs since; needs to find more

runners.name: Baby G
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two sprint runs this summer; no appeal.
runners.comment: Modest form in two sprint runs this summer; no appeal

runners.name: Hanaan
runners.spotlight: 50-1 for her debut at Kempton (7f, AW) nine weeks ago, weakening in the final furlong; drop in trip/addition of a tongue-tie needs to spark a jolt of progress; worth a market check all the same.
runners.comment: 50-1 when last of nine in a 7f AW novice on debut; drops in trip with a tongue-tie added

runners.name: Mimime
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two sprint runs this summer; minor handicaps should prove more suitable.
runners.comment: Modest form in two sprint runs this summer; minor handicaps should prove more suitable

runners.name: Cercis
runners.spotlight: Ran green when a well-beaten fifth of six in a 5f fillies' novice here (good to soft) in October; sold out of Ed Walker's stable for 11,000gns later that month; hooded for stable/seasonal debut.
runners.comment: Down the field over 5f here in one 2yo run for Ed Walker; sold 11,000gns since; now hooded

races.race_name: Watch Racing TV Now Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Havana Gift
runners.spotlight: Possibly going to prove an ordinary sort, having produced best effort in a seller on penultimate start; however, ran respectably (fourth of seven) in C&D nursery latest and looks a reasonably solid contender kept to this scenario; Warren Fentiman takes off a useful 3lb.
runners.comment: Best effort in seller on penultimate start; ran respectably in C&D nursery latest

runners.name: Our Fella
runners.spotlight: Creditable second off top weight in Class 6 event at Ffos Las (5f, good; nursery debut) last Tuesday, backing up the form of his 66-1 placed effort a couple of starts earlier; upped in grade but receives weight all round this time, albeit from rivals who already have course form.
runners.comment: Creditable second in Class 6 nursery at Ffos Las last week; steps up in grade

runners.name: Glamorize
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who hit a flat spot then rallied well in first-time cheekpieces over C&D (good to firm) most recently, getting up close home; may build on that novice win and show further progress in the retained headgear; not disgraced at Royal Ascot the time before; respected.
runners.comment: Rallied well in first-time cheekpieces over C&D most recently; may build on that win

races.race_name: Dine In Sherwoods Restaurant Handicap

runners.name: Takeitorleaveit
runners.spotlight: His two wins have come over 1m at Bath, the more recent coming off a 3lb lower mark in April; runner-up on his last three starts and no obvious reason why he wouldn't be in the thick of it.
runners.comment: Bath winner (1m) in April; runner-up on last three starts; should be in the thick of it

runners.name: Beauty Generation
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for new stable when taking a 1m2f handicap here (good to firm) 19 days ago; a 3lb rise shouldn't be an issue but he wouldn't want this to get tactical.
runners.comment: 1m2f win here 19 days ago; 3lb rise manageable but he wouldn't want a tactical event

runners.name: The Bureau Club
runners.spotlight: Just a glimmer of promise in her five starts, the latest her handicap debut at Windsor (1m, good to firm) five weeks ago; still has time to do better but she needs more for the additional yardage.
runners.comment: Glimmer of promise in her five starts but she will need improvement for the longer trip

runners.name: Katalyst
runners.spotlight: Ran well from the front here (1m, good to soft; blinkered first time) in May but she has followed it with two heavy defeats; down in the weights but she is not a solid option.
runners.comment: Ran okay here on good to soft in May but two heavy defeats have followed; enough to prove

runners.name: Horwich
runners.spotlight: Consistency has been a major issue for him but he has the ability to win at this level; this will be the longest trip he has tackled but it looks worth trying.
runners.comment: Inconsistent but capable; new trip worth exploring; could have a big run in him

runners.name: Sahm Naif
runners.spotlight: Comes here chasing a hat-trick after narrow 1m2f wins on fast ground at Beverley and Redcar (cheekpieces first time); a 6lb penalty for the latter success (on Sunday) asks a stiffer question, but he could enjoy the run of the race and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Chasing a hat-trick after two 1m2f wins, the latest on Sunday; big player despite penalty

races.race_name: Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Distant Shore
runners.spotlight: Hooded all starts; dead-heated in her sole outing as a 2yo and back to form when beaten a head at Sandown (1m, good) last month; up 4lb, but the form of that race is working out well; respected.
runners.comment: 4lb higher than when beaten a head at Sandown last month, but the form is working out well

runners.name: Porth Eilian
runners.spotlight: 2-3 since handicapping, with both wins coming at around 1m on good to firm ground at Hamilton and Beverley; high on list despite a 4lb higher mark.
runners.comment: 2-3 since handicapping, both wins coming at around 1m on good to firm ground; high on list
runners.owner: Julie & David Martin, Dan Hall & Partner

runners.name: Darzah
runners.spotlight: A bit up and down in her four starts, but she did it well enough when successful at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month, beating Luna Celeste by just under a length; 3lb rise fair enough, though not quite sure how strong the form is with the third and fourth both finishing out of the frame since.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than when winning at Newmarket last month, but not sure how strong the form is

runners.name: Luna Celeste
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark with a narrow success in a Leicester maiden (6f, good to firm) in May and was beaten less than a length by Darzah on handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last month; now 2lb better off with her old rival, but a couple of those behind haven't boosted the form since.
runners.comment: Closely matched with Darzah on last month's Newmarket running, but form not boosted

runners.name: Great Mates
runners.spotlight: Disappointed when sent off favourite for her stable debut/reappearance at Newmarket (7f. good; first-time hood) last month, but made no mistake at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) 19 days ago; 3lb higher and meets some less exposed rivals, though the sole 4yo beat four 3yos in this race last year.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than when winning on her second start for the yard at Yarmouth last time

races.race_name: Construction Day 14th Oct Handicap

runners.name: Hoodie Hoo
runners.spotlight: Second to Jenever over C&D last October but held by that rival at the revised weights; his form has dipped on his last two starts but he's capable of a prominent showing.
runners.comment: Ties in with Jenever on a C&D run last October; needs to rebound from two quiet efforts
runners.owner: Ged Mason, Sir Alex Ferguson, Jim McGoff

runners.name: Loquella
runners.spotlight: First and second in two 6f novice runs on AW over the winter; no impact in three handicap runs, including her turf debut 17 days ago, and may need further help from the assessor.
runners.comment: First and second in two AW novices; no show in three handicaps; may need more weight off

runners.name: Southern Warrior
runners.spotlight: His 6f AW win for George Scott in March came off this mark; unplaced in both runs for his new stable and others have more pressing claims.
runners.comment: AW win off this mark for former yard; well held in both starts for new trainer; opposable

runners.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners.spotlight: Two wins and a second from three visits to Nottingham, all over this trip on fast ground; 1lb higher than for his latest second; one to take seriously.
runners.comment: Three C&D runs have yielded two wins and a close 2nd (17 days ago); bang there once more

runners.name: Dark Kestrel
runners.spotlight: Better on AW than turf but handicapped accordingly; not beaten far at Wetherby on his penultimate start but this is a better race and he has since finished down the field at Wolverhampton.
runners.comment: Better on AW but handicapped accordingly; disappointed at Wolverhampton latest

runners.name: Logi Bear
runners.spotlight: Won a Newmarket novice (6f, good) last May, his third start, but beaten 11 times since including all four runs for John Butler; his penultimate second at Thirsk was a good run though and when down the field at York last time it was a Class 4; not out of it.
runners.comment: Penultimate 2nd brings him into the reckoning and latest defeat came in a Class 4; chance

runners.name: Sixtygeesbaby
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in six runs for David O'Meara, but he's tumbling down the weights and he showed more at York (6f, good to firm; visored first time) ten days ago; this is a drop in class and something bigger is brewing.
runners.comment: Showed more in a visor at York 10 days ago; drops in class and something bigger is brewing

runners.name: Jenever
runners.spotlight: Like many from the yard he has had a quiet year but he has dropped down the weights and is now 6lb lower than for his C&D win last October; quite possible the winners will start flowing for Jessica Macey now and he's of some interest.
runners.comment: Yard off the mark for the year on Saturday and this C&D winner is attractively handicapped

races.race_name: RMG Proudly Supports Teenage Cancer Trust Handicap

runners.name: Come On Over
runners.spotlight: No problem with 7f last backend and he has been running over 6f this summer, latterly when making all at Doncaster early in the month; came away with a subsequent winner that day and finally getting off the mark should have helped confidence; a 4lb rise looks fair.
runners.comment: Finally getting off the mark should have helped confidence and a 4lb rise looks fair
runners.owner: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd

runners.name: Coyy
runners.spotlight: Has not had much luck and continues to give the impression that this mark, which is just 2lb higher than when winning at Windsor in the spring, is within range; another who tends to be ridden from off the pace and he wouldn't want a messy affair.
runners.comment: Has not had much luck; wouldn't want a messy affair over an easy 5f; claims otherwise

runners.name: Mondammej
runners.spotlight: Winless on turf since 2021 but showed more on his second run back from a break last time, is now 2lb lower and this is easier than the handicaps he's used to contesting; tends to be held up and a speed-favouring 5f in a small field may not be optimal but he's capable.
runners.comment: A speed-favouring 5f in a small field may not be optimal but he's capable

runners.name: Squealer
runners.spotlight: York win last summer came off 15lb higher, which shows how things have gone in the meantime; can miss the break (including in first-time headgear latest; now removed) but this race is easier than he's used to; career-low mark.
runners.comment: Can miss the break but this race is easier than he's used to; career-low mark

races.race_name: O'Hare's Bar Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Bells Grove
runners.spotlight: Placed all three bumper starts for John McConnell, including Cheltenham third in October where he was a neck off a Skelton horse who has won three hurdles since and is now rated 137; after six months off, unplaced in a Kilbeggan bumper on stable debut; good third of 17 on hurdling debut at Listowel in late May; not much of note behind him, but winner had landed a bumper impressively and runner-up was sixth in the Asoct Stakes next time.
runners.comment: Useful in bumpers for John McConnell; good third of 17 on hurdling debut at Listowel

runners.name: Whoyougonnacall
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in soft-ground bumper here last year; was shaping well on hurdling debut at Clonmel when knuckling on landing two out, fourth at the time and with running left to give; well beaten in Roscommon novice latest, but the three ahead of him were all previous winners; place chance.
runners.comment: Was shaping well when falling two out on hurdling debut at Clonmel; held in novice latest

runners.name: Ripsnorter
runners.spotlight: Won on his third bumper start for Andy Slattery when making all at Roscommon in August; well held on yard debut in Listowel maiden hurdle the following month, and ran like he needed his comeback at Tramore in late May.
runners.comment: Penalised for his bumper win when with Andy Slattery; only okay runs in first two hurdles

runners.name: How's Ellie
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite but not a bad run in first bumper at Galway in October, beaten 9l; not as good next time and, for one from champion trainer's yard, significant that she was sent off 22-1 when beaten 42l on hurdling debut at Roscommon
runners.comment: Beaten favourite but not a bad run in first bumper; beaten 42l on hurdling debut lately

runners.name: Tiffany Case
runners.spotlight: Diamond Boy mare cost 50,000euros at three; half-sister to winners Scorpion's Revenge (bumper/useful US 2m2f hurdle), Arthur Fonzarelli (2m1f hurdle) and Neigh Botha (bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle/chase); dam unraced half-sister to Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Native River.
runners.comment: Diamond Boy mare cost 50,000euros at three; half-sister to three winners

runners.name: Spanish Rising
runners.spotlight: Phoenix Of Spain half-brother to five Flat winners was second in 1m2f maiden at Ripon last year, when trained by the owner's son; well beaten in three starts on the Flat in Ireland; tongue-tie fitted for hurdling debut; can be keen.
runners.comment: Second over 1m2f at Ripon last year; well beaten on the Flat in Ireland; tongue-tie fitted

runners.name: Pit River
runners.spotlight: First reserve; newcomer by the Motivator stallion For Fun, a Grade 1 winner over hurdles in France; cost 24,00euros at two; dam unraced half-sister to French/German 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner; family of smart miler Enrique.
runners.comment: Newcomer by the Motivator stallion For Fun; cost 24,00euros at two; reserve

runners.name: Vocology
runners.spotlight: Modest on the Flat, rated just 34; can only be watched on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Modest and rated just 34 on the Flat; can only be watched

runners.name: Mr Caulfield
runners.spotlight: Valirann gelding off the mark on seventh starts in points in May, when with John Edward Walsh; hood on for stable/rules debut.
runners.comment: Valirann gelding off the mark on seventh starts in points; hood on for rules debut

runners.name: Norvoski
runners.spotlight: Newcomer by Aizavoski cost 12,500euros as 3yo; second foal; dam unraced sister to bumper and useful jumps winner Shoal Bay.
runners.comment: Newcomer by Aizavoski; dam unraced sister to bumper and useful jumps winner Shoal Bay

runners.name: Neat As A Pin
runners.spotlight: 33s, hampered and unseated rider at the second at Roscommon; will need this experience.
runners.comment: 33s, hampered and unseated rider at the second at Roscommon; will need this experience

runners.name: Online Order
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle

runners.name: Humble Berkshire
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten so far, although the Sligo maiden in which she was beaten 22l on her penultimate start has produced three winners.
runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten so far, although Sligo run two starts back wasn't without merit

runners.name: Poetic Parable
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; sent off 66-1 for Roscommon maiden hurdle and was beaten 42l.
runners.comment: Sent off 66-1 for Roscommon maiden hurdle and was beaten 42l; reserve

runners.name: Pretty Wild
runners.spotlight: 20s when ridden by Harry Cobden in Roscommon maiden hurdle, beaten 43l; will need more time.
runners.comment: 20s for debut under Harry Cobden in Roscommon maiden hurdle, beaten 43l; needs more time

runners.name: Turlough Abu
runners.spotlight: Nothing so far Flat or hurdles.
runners.comment: Nothing so far Flat or hurdles

runners.name: Emmamia
runners.spotlight: 40s, never invoved when beaten 30l on debut in maiden hurdle at Sligo.
runners.comment: 40s, never involved when beaten 30l on debut in maiden hurdle at Sligo

runners.name: Rosarian
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; ran okay in an Academy Hurdle on testing ground at Navan in December, beaten 15l.
runners.comment: Ran okay in Academy Hurdle on testing ground at Navan in December, beaten 15l; reserve

races.race_name: West "Howya" Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Whats New
runners.spotlight: Flat winner has a kink in him, and has twice run out, but solid seconds last twice and there was good money for him last time when clear of the remainder at Sligo, beaten around 2l by 115-rated rival; ground suits and this is a good opportunity.
runners.comment: Flat winner has a kink in him, and has twice run out, but solid seconds last twice

runners.name: World As One
runners.spotlight: Waldgeist gelding is a sibling of nine winners, notably smart hurdler Colonel Mustard; beaten favourite all starts; one-paced in two bumpers over farther; no extra in fifth on hurdling bow at Roscommon, after being messed about by a loose horse and making mistakes; a less eventful contest should see a better performance in a first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Fav all starts; pair of ok bumper runs; mistakes and no luck in running on hurdling bow

runners.name: Sharu
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two bumpers before hurdling debut sixth at Tramore; 2-1 fav at Kilbeggan, travelled well to challenge but stuck his head up on the run-in and was inclined to lug in behind the winner; that raises a concern and bit to find with Whats New on the figures.
runners.comment: 2-1 fav for modest Kilbeggan maiden, finished 2.5l second and carried head high on run-in

runners.name: Phyllis Rodda
runners.spotlight: Rules debut for Berkshire half-sister to smart staying jumper Salvador Ziggy; pulled up in two point runs with a week of each other last October.
runners.comment: Rules debut for half-sister to smart staying jumper Salvador Ziggy; pulled up in points

runners.name: Minnatrix
runners.spotlight: Second in Roscommon bumper last year; two mishaps after, including a fall when out of contention on only hurdles run; beaten 20l in bumper latest.
runners.comment: Second in Roscommon bumper last year; two mishaps after, and beaten 20l in bumper latest

runners.name: Lady Felicia
runners.spotlight: Homebred Jukebox Jury mare whose dam was useful 2m4f/2m5f hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; fine run when 100-1 in 2m maiden hurdle here, beaten 17l and splitting two subsequent winners; gets an extra furlong here, but will probably want 2m4f before long; still, should go well in first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Fine run when 100-1 in 2m maiden hurdle here; beaten 17l and split two subsequent winners
runners.owner: Ms Margaret Nevin & Ms Alana Insole

runners.name: Alfinthesea
runners.spotlight: Affinisea half-brother to 2m3f/3m hurdle winner Cosmo Renfro; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m4f-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Shang Tang, out of bumper/2m hurdle winner.
runners.comment: Affinisea half-brother to 2m3f/3m hurdle winner Cosmo Renfro

runners.name: First Ascent
runners.spotlight: Godolphin cast-off related to Group winners; decent maiden form last summer for Matt Smith, including  narrow defeat in 10.5f maiden at Down Royal, and raced off 78 when last seen in that sphere (Whats New is 62 on the Flat); lame on hurdles debut; after seven months off, beaten 20l at Sligo in May where jumping was novicey late on.
runners.comment: Decent maiden form on the Flat last summer; beaten 20l on first completed run over hurdles

runners.name: Breezingwithdstars
runners.spotlight: Best run was when beaten 27l in Roscommon maiden hurdle; tailed off other starts under rules.
runners.comment: Best run was when beaten 27l in Roscommon maiden hurdle; tailed off other rules' starts

runners.name: Kilmond Knight
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a point and only got as far as the first flight of hurdles here in May.
runners.comment: Pulled up in point and only got as far as the first flight of hurdles here in May

runners.name: Rumi Rock
runners.spotlight: Best of four point runs was on debut when 4l off useful type; tailed off in bumper latest.
runners.comment: Best of four point runs was on debut when 4l off useful type; tailed off in bumper latest

runners.name: No Mon No Fun
runners.spotlight: Fancied for two points but failed to complete; 30l fourth over 2m4f on hurdling debut at Limerick gives him something to build on.
runners.comment: Fancied for two points but failed to complete; 30l fourth over 2m4f on hurdling debut

runners.name: Middlethird Marvel
runners.spotlight: Big prices and has shown little in bumpers and over hurdles; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Big prices and has shown little in bumpers and over hurdles; new headgear combination

races.race_name: David Heneghan Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Le Diablo
runners.spotlight: Won 2m1f Clonmel handicap in April (yielding), followed that with a couple of ordinary runs off revised mark; good chance now following a return to form with Wexford second; yard has been among the winners lately and tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Yard has been among the winners lately, good chance following Wexford second, tongue-tie

runners.name: Marlpark
runners.spotlight: Has shown his best form at Clonmel, but was pulled up at that venue on his most recent start; previous fourth at Limerick was no more than satisfactory.
runners.comment: Has shown his best form at Clonmel, but was pulled up at that venue on most recent start

runners.name: Bhean Saibhre
runners.spotlight: Had been mixing Flat and hurdling action to useful effect before an off-day at this venue in May; hard to fancy after another poor run at Limerick.
runners.comment: Fair Flat/hurdles form in the spring, pulled up here in May, another poor run at Limerick

runners.name: Ballinvasas Best
runners.spotlight: Some promise in 2024 maiden runs; tailed off at Listowel in May on first run after a long layoff; handicap debut now.
runners.comment: Some promise in 2024 maiden runs, tailed off at Listowel in May on first run after layoff

runners.name: At The Wings
runners.spotlight: Took a small step in the right direction on seasonal debut at Sligo, much more required; 2lb wrong but useful 5lb claimed.
runners.comment: Took a small step in the right direction on seasonal debut at Sligo, much more required

runners.name: Max Meridius
runners.spotlight: Ended last Flat season with a respectable fifth on handicap debut in a 25-runner 1m2f Curragh race on heavy ground; fit from hurdling before beginning new Flat campaign with an encouraging fifth at Leopardstown; not as good at that venue last time, but may improve on previous hurdling form.
runners.comment: Recent form on the Flat provides some encouragement, may improve on previous hurdling form

runners.name: Houndsworth
runners.spotlight: Shock win when bolting up at 40-1 off 93 at Cork in April (2m, yielding); mid-field off revised mark at Limerick later that month, when testing ground may not have suited; unplaced favourite in a novice contest at Downpatrick last month.
runners.comment: Shock win when bolting up at Cork in April, confidence dented by two subsequent outings

runners.name: Valsorpresa
runners.spotlight: Won a Downpatrick maiden hurdle for Gordon Elliott in April 2024; Galway fifth (2m, good to yielding) last October was best effort since joining this yard; should be better for his run at this track in May.
runners.comment: Should be better for his run at this track in May, sole win was for Gordon Elliott in 2024

runners.name: Doctor Confusion
runners.spotlight: Some promise in two maiden hurdles in 2024 but was disappointing when favourite on return at Tipperary early last season; pulled up on handicap debut last August; absent since; from a top stable, so not ruled out
runners.comment: From a top stable, form is modest, pulled up on handicap debut last August, absent since

races.race_name: RBC Brewin Dolphin Rated Novice Hurdle

runners.name: Manoir De Mirande
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper in France, but had proved frustrating over hurdles until off the mark on ninth start in this discipline when making all over this trip in a Sligo maiden; runner-up has leading claims in 5.06 on this card; son of It's Gino with poster-boy looks and should make a nice chaser in time.
runners.comment: Off the mark on ninth start over hurdles when making all in a Sligo maiden

runners.name: Crystabel
runners.spotlight: Up front throughout when winning Sligo handicap over this trip; effectively 10lb higher, but further progress is likely.
runners.comment: Up front throughout when winning Sligo handicap over this trip; effectively 10lb higher
runners.owner: M R D Fleming & G Bruce & J P Ryan & Miss G Ryan

runners.name: Lureka Du Noyer
runners.spotlight: Plenty of experience over hurdles and fences in France, had nine runs as 4yo; after a break, was well-backed winner of 2m maiden hurdle at Limerick and third won by a street lately; tackles good ground for the first time, but Doctor Dino's progeny are rarely troubled by it, nor is his talented brother and stablemate Zurich.
runners.comment: Plenty of experience over hurdles and fences in France; well-backed winner at Limerick

runners.name: Eyeeye
runners.spotlight: Long-standing maiden in both codes; second in claiming hurdle at Sligo two runs back; 7lb wrong at the weights and hard to fancy in this company.
runners.comment: Second in claimer at Sligo two runs back; 7lb wrong and hard to fancy in this company

runners.name: Move It On Over
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all eight starts and all of 31lb wrong at the weights; would need to start now.
runners.comment: Unplaced all eight starts and all of 31lb wrong at the weights; would need to start now

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Home Of The Early Payout Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Spinola Bay
runners.spotlight: Came back from a long layoff to start last season's campaign with back-to-back handicap wins at Navan (soft-to-heavy) and Leopardstown (yielding); beaten favourite in two novice hurdles in January; perhaps some doubt about how he will handle the ground.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in two novice hurdles in January, won last December after a long break

runners.name: Eye Contact
runners.spotlight: Had shown little, Flat or hurdles, before running way above expectations (300-1) in a conditions hurdle at this venue in May; another fair run in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle; down the field in a Flat handicap at Limerick last time; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Best form when running way above expectations in a conditions hurdle at this venue in May

runners.name: Eye Of A Tiger
runners.spotlight: Has lost her way since winning a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last August; beaten 24l in mares' handicap hurdle at this venue
runners.comment: Has lost her way since winning a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last August, stable in form

runners.name: Ballyearl
runners.spotlight: Won a Tipperary maiden hurdle last year; pulled up in a chase at Wexford last month; had an excuse (badly hampered four out) when well beaten at last year's Galway festival on his only handicap hurdle outing.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a chase at Wexford last month, well beaten on his only handicap hurdle outing

runners.name: Space Warrior
runners.spotlight: No success since a juvenile maiden hurdle win at Fairyhouse in November 2024; has dropped a long way in the ratings from an opening mark of 111 to 94; should enter calculations based on a third placing at Clonmel in April.
runners.comment: Now 17lb below career-high, enters calculations based on third placing at Clonmel in April
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Mullins & M J Lomax

runners.name: Fiveonefive
runners.spotlight: Has recorded three of his five hurdle starts at Cartmel; below his best there last time; overall Irish form is unconvincing.
runners.comment: Has recorded three of his five hurdle starts at Cartmel, below his best there last time

runners.name: Wolf Prince
runners.spotlight: Ended his time with Fergal O'Brien with back-to-back hurdle wins at Taunton and Chepstow in March/April 2024; after a long absence, had two Flat runs (including a satisfactory display at this venue) before being sent back over hurdles at Sligo nine days ago; made all and has a good chance despite 5lb rise.
runners.comment: Flat run at this venue prefaced a hurdles win at Sligo, good chance despite 5lb rise

runners.name: Free Flow
runners.spotlight: Sole win for Ross O'Sullivan came in a Thurles maiden hurdle (2m, good) the season before last; weak handicap form last season; hard to make a case for him on stable debut.
runners.comment: Weak handicap form last season, hard to make a case for him on stable debut

runners.name: Sir Allen
runners.spotlight: 2-14 over hurdles; returned from a long layoff with a decisive Flat win at Navan in March (1m6f, heavy); well beaten off this hurdles mark at Roscommon last month; capable of better, appears to be ground-versatile.
runners.comment: Flat winner on heavy in March, well beaten off this hurdles mark at Roscommon last month

runners.name: Dontgowithjoe
runners.spotlight: Returns from an 11-month layoff on a hat-trick after back-to-back victories at this venue and Bellewstown, both on good ground, last August; has gone up a total of 13lb; further progress is feasible.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick after successive wins at this venue and Bellewstown last August

races.race_name: Sweeney Oil Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Coppola
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in races at Down Royal (twice) and Downpatrick in March/April; struggled in first-time cheekpieces at Kilbeggan; same story when cheekpieces discarded for chase debut at Downpatrick; hard to be confident.
runners.comment: Runner-up in races at Down Royal (twice) and Downpatrick in March/April, weak recent form

runners.name: Bearami Creek
runners.spotlight: Good form last autumn, highlighted by Navan win over 2m3f (yielding) off 90; totally out of sorts in three runs since returning from a winter break in April.
runners.comment: Good form last autumn, out of sorts in two races this year, plenty to prove now
runners.owner: G F O'Neill & W Ward & Ms Bernadette Leigh

runners.name: Whatyouwant
runners.spotlight: Brought off an 80-1 shock at Kilbeggan last autumn when fitted with cheekpieces for the first time; remote seventh at Limerick early this month after a break; got a lot closer to the same winner when fifth at Kilbeggan the following week.
runners.comment: Brought off an 80-1 shock at Kilbeggan last autumn, not a bad run at that track last time

runners.name: Sineads Fancy
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) nearly two years ago; third at Thurles over same trip last October her best run since; down the field in two runs in May,
runners.comment: Sole win came in at Downpatrick almost two years ago, down the field in two runs in May

runners.name: My Good Pal
runners.spotlight: Last four runs have been over fences, with the best of them a Downpatrick second behind the much-improved Dinoland; decent form in handicap hurdles towards the end of 2025, placed three times in a row at around 2m4f; 1-19 hurdle record is negative; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, last four runs have been over fences, 1-19 hurdles record is negative

runners.name: Run For The Border
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden on good-to-yielding over 2m3f at Limerick last October; probably not suited by testing ground in two runs before a break; encouraging run after five months off when third in an 18-runner contest at Limerick in May; stable in good form, solid chance.
runners.comment: Pleasing third in an 18-runner contest at Limerick in May, the stable is in good form

runners.name: Vroomvroomboo
runners.spotlight: Placed three times at around 2m4f; lost form after a good run at Cork 12 months ago; towards the rear in a maiden at Dowpatickm last month.
runners.comment: Placed three times at around 2m4f, lost form after a good run at Cork 12 months ago

runners.name: Coole Vision
runners.spotlight: Returned from almost three years off when pulled up in a point in February; weakened to finish tenth of 16 at Sligo six weeks ago on his first hurdles start since 2023.
runners.comment: Faded to finish tenth of 16 at Sligo six weeks ago on his first hurdles start since 2023

runners.name: It's Time Again
runners.spotlight: All three hurdle wins have come at this venue, the last one in 2025; pulled up over C&D in May; was in the process of running a good race when falling in the lead two from home at Clonmel last month; 10yo mare could go well if suffering no ill effects.
runners.comment: In the process of running a good race when falling in the lead two from home at Clonmel

runners.name: Light Her Up
runners.spotlight: Modest form, fair sixth on handicap debut (2m, good to yielding) at Thurles last November; absent since a poor run over 2m4f on soft ground the following month; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, generally modest form and lacks the advantage of a recent run

runners.name: Will It Be You
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in May 2024; lost form after fourth placing at Limerick later that year; failed to make his presence felt over fences last season; struggled on his return to hurdling at Roscommon recently.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May 2024, lost form after fourth placing at Limerick later that year

runners.name: Ballinaboola Hanna
runners.spotlight: Beaten by big margins in maiden hurdles, hood on for handicap debut; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve; beaten by big margins in maiden hurdles, hood on for handicap debut

runners.name: Ranger Billy
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner; badly out of form last summer; back from absence when pulled up in Cork handicap hurdle; suffered the same fate over fences at Limerick.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a Cork handicap hurdle in May, suffered the same fate over fences at Limerick

runners.name: Not So Serious
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; pulled up in handicaps at Kilbeggan (twice) and Tramore in recent months; transformation required in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Pulled up in handicaps at Kilbeggan (twice) and Tramore in recent months; cheekpieces

runners.name: Tantrum Boy
runners.spotlight: Some improvement at Limerick last time, but still needs plenty more; cheekpieces discarded.
runners.comment: Some improvement at Limerick last time but still needs plenty more, cheekpieces discarded

runners.name: Lost Features
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in four handicap attempts; 66-1 chance when pulled up at Sligo nine days ago.
runners.comment: Has struggled in four handicap attempts, 66-1 chance when pulled up at Sligo last time
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Madame Masque
runners.spotlight: Point winner two years ago; respectable run on debut at Gowran last November; given a break after two subsequent poor efforts; tongue-tie on now for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Point winner in 2024, modest form in maiden hurdles, tongue-tie on for handicap debut

runners.name: John Dixen
runners.spotlight: Never a factor in four maiden hurdles; needs to step up considerably from his first handicap run at Limerick.
runners.comment: Weak maiden form, needs to step up considerably from his first handicap run at Limerick

races.race_name: Sweeney Oil Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Toor Moon
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 39 starts, placed 11 times; unseated in a chase on latest; not a betting proposition.
runners.comment: 39-race maiden, placed 11 times; unseated in a chase on latest, not a betting proposition

runners.name: Granlahan
runners.spotlight: Promoted to third at Limerick in May after the winner's disqualification; followed that with a fair third at Sligo; hampered and unseated at the sixth at Bellewstown; back in the money when third at Kilbeggan last time; one of the more appealing runners.
runners.comment: Has reached the money in three of his last four races, one of the more appealing runners

runners.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners.spotlight: Won a Punchestown handicap hurdle (2m4f, good) last October off 87; decent third on handicap chase debut at Punchestown in June; brought down in a hurdle race at Bellewstown early this month; holds a definite chance after a recent third placing at Sligo; cheekpieces may help.
runners.comment: Holds a definite chance after a recent third placing at Sligo, cheekpieces may help

runners.name: Whiskey Serenade
runners.spotlight: Point winner for Colin Bowe; placed in a modest maiden hurdle for Gavin Cromwell last summer; shaped promisingly when second to a fellow outsider at Bellewstown on first run for this stable; could provide the solution.
runners.comment: Shaped promisingly at Bellewstown on first run for this stable, could provide the solution

runners.name: Mollys Dolly
runners.spotlight: Never in the first four in nine starts over hurdles; not an obvious contender following a poor run at Limerick early this month; previous run at the same venue was better.
runners.comment: Never in the first four in nine starts over hurdles, not an obvious contender

runners.name: Smackwater Jack
runners.spotlight: Veteran was a long way out of the handicap when achieving a Punchestown win last month, the third success of a 34-race career; solid display when third at Kilbeggan off his revised mark; stays well.
runners.comment: Veteran was a long way out of the handicap for Punchestown win, solid display at Kilbeggan

runners.name: La Tene
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward over hurdles when third at Clonmel in March (2m3f, soft); well below that level over fences at Tramore next time; has failed to complete his last two races; stable in form, good 5lb claimer.
runners.comment: Has failed to deliver on the promise of a third placing on soft going at Clonmel in March
runners.owner: John Patrick Ryan & Miss Gillian Ryan

runners.name: Ladiam
runners.spotlight: Has recorded her only two wins at Sligo; placed eight times, including four seconds at this venue; remote fifth over C&D on his latest start; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, two wins at Sligo, has been placed at this venue on four occasions

runners.name: Fool Me Once
runners.spotlight: Has looked badly out of form in two 2026 outings; maiden, placed twice from 15 starts.
runners.comment: Has looked badly out of form in two 2026 races, maiden, placed three times from 15 starts

runners.name: Strong Contender
runners.spotlight: Beaten around 10l in seventh at Kilbeggan in her first handicap; left with quite a bit to do then; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Beaten around 10l in seventh at Kilbeggan in her first handicap, open to improvement

runners.name: She'll Be Kept
runners.spotlight: Fair placed form in points; has a modest record on the track; needs to raise her game after finishing sixth at Limerick last time.
runners.comment: Fair placed form in points, has a modest record on the track, needs to raise her game

runners.name: Lady Aquarelle
runners.spotlight: Modest overall form; has failed to reach the first six in six outings in 2026; hard to be confident unless a tongue-tie makes a big difference.
runners.comment: Has failed to reach the first six in six outings in 2026, hard to be confident

runners.name: Yolanda's Star
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced mare; improved display when third over 2m at Kilbeggan last time; this trip may not be ideal.
runners.comment: Improved display when third over 2m at Kilbeggan last time, this trip may not be ideal

runners.name: Stumblin In
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m6f Tramore handicap hurdle in April last year; fair run at Clonmel early last month; down the field when quite well fancied (9-2) at Limerick last time.
runners.comment: Won a 2m6f Tramore handicap hurdle in April last year, fair run on penultimate start

runners.name: Jolly Potter
runners.spotlight: Moderate French hurdles form; unraced during a spell with Gordon Elliott; has done nothing to advertise his chance of gaining a breakthrough win.
runners.comment: French import who has done nothing to advertise his chance of gaining a breakthrough win

runners.name: Joshua Chamberlain
runners.spotlight: Easily won a 2m5f Tramore handicap hurdle off in August 2023; down the field at Punchestown after a very long absence.
runners.comment: Won at Tramore in 2023, down the field at Punchestown after a very long absence
runners.owner: J R Robinson & Mrs E Keane

runners.name: Leis Fein
runners.spotlight: Never in the first three; getting on in years now andhard to make a case for him; only positive is that his trainer has always been associated with having fine record with veterans; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, never in the first three, getting on in years now, hard to make a case

runners.name: Rushford
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins in 2022; finished last in two Dundalk runs after a long absence, and well held in latest three runs on turf; fifth in a Tramore handicap in 2024 was his best effort over hurdles.
runners.comment: Two Flat wins in 2022, poor Flat form after long absence

runners.name: John Storey
runners.spotlight: Big-field Fairyhouse handicap hurdle winner on New Year's Day 2025, his only success from 17 starts over hurdles; pulled up on his only two appearances in 2026; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, 1-17 over hurdles, pulled up on his only two appearances in 2026

races.race_name: Jennings Meats INH Flat Race

runners.name: Tommy's Ticket
runners.spotlight: Jet Away 5yo was only 9-1 for Kilbeggan debut; raced prominently and keenly before fading; beaten less than 7l, but the fact that only around 10l covered the first 10 home gives the form a dubious look; hood might help.
runners.comment: Jet Away 5yo was only 9-1 for Kilbeggan debut, beaten less than 7l having been keen; hood

runners.name: Long Story
runners.spotlight: 80s, much better on second start when beaten 8.5l at Kilbeggan where he looked green before staying on late; that's not hectic form, but has a place shout.
runners.comment: Much better on second start when beaten 8.5l at Kilbeggan

runners.name: Ballybollen
runners.spotlight: Nathaniel half-brother was a cheap yearling; half-brother to four winners, notably Stuart Crawford's useful bumper and hurdles performer Mongibello; dam French 1m1f/10.5f winner, half-sister to French 2m5f Grade 3 hurdle winner; bar set low for debut.
runners.comment: Nathaniel half-brother to four winners, notably useful bumper/hurdles performer Mongibello

runners.name: Srah
runners.spotlight: Homebred by Rajj; fourth foal; unraced dam is out of half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Flakey Dove; yard only 3-86 in bumpers last five seasons.
runners.comment: Homebred by Rajj; unraced dam is out of half-sister to Champion Hurdle winner Flakey Dove

runners.name: Josh's Jury
runners.spotlight: 25s for Navan debut last September, prominent until weakening 2f out when beaten 18l in fair race.
runners.comment: 25s for Navan debut last September, prominent until weakening when beaten 18l in fair race

runners.name: Millers Point
runners.spotlight: Cost 40,000euros as 3yo; half-brother to bumper/2m hurdle winner The Model Kingdom and dam also won a bumper; smart family farther back in the pedigree as well; fancied for both points but failed to complete.
runners.comment: Was fancied for both points but failed to complete; half-brother to bumper winner

runners.name: Colga Boys
runners.spotlight: Newcomer by Feels Like Dancing; first foal; dam unplaced bumpers/maiden hurdles, sister to 2m3f-3m hurdle winner Onlyfoolsownhorses, half-sister to three other hurdle winners; yard 0-35 in bumpers last five seasons.
runners.comment: Newcomer by Feels Like Dancing; dam unplaced bumpers/maiden hurdles

runners.name: Merci Vieil Ami
runners.spotlight: Diamond Boy half-brother to three winners in France, including Le But (1m2f-1m3f Flat and useful 2m1f-2m4f hurdle/chase); dam Flat/hurdles winner, half-sister to Eoin Griffin's smart dual-purpose mare Lounaos; no joy in two point outings.
runners.comment: No joy in two point outings for Diamond Boy half-brother to three winners; rules debut

runners.name: Moundofthehostages
runners.spotlight: In-form yard but 5yo has shown nothing so far in a bumper and maiden hurdle; headgear left off this time.
runners.comment: Tailed off in a bumper and maiden hurdle; headgear left off this time

runners.name: Pamelaisbrass
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in heavy-ground contest at Naas before being beaten 36l at Bellewstown lately.
runners.comment: Tailed off in heavy-ground contest at Naas before being beaten 36l at Bellewstown lately

runners.name: Saviour Blu
runners.spotlight: Has run twice in Roscommon hurdles; beaten a long way last year and early exit lately.
runners.comment: Has run twice in Roscommon hurdles; beaten a long way last year and early exit lately

runners.name: Hometomayo
runners.spotlight: Has run in three points, a bumper and a maiden hurdle; seems modest.
runners.comment: Has run in points, a bumper and a maiden hurdle; seems modest

runners.name: Ealu Tapa
runners.spotlight: Homebred Getaway gelding; dam placed over 1m5f, sister to yard's high-class jumper Peregrine Run and Takeyourcapoff (1m6f Flat and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle), out of bumper winner; only 11-2 when mid-division in 18-runner bumper at Punchestown; should be capable of better and anything Adam Ryan rides in bumpers is always worth a second glance.
runners.comment: Nice pedigree and only 11-2 when mid-division at Punchestown; should be capable of better

races.race_name: Highclere Castle Horse Feeds "Carnarvon" Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Margorie
runners.spotlight: Novice winner who is 0-6 in handicaps but ran encouragingly at Chepstow (6f; finished well from rear) most recently and is now a stone below her opening mark; interesting dropped to 0-55 level.
runners.comment: 0-6 in handicaps but ran encouragingly last time and is now a stone below opening mark

runners.name: Endowed
runners.spotlight: Has gained all wins over 6f but went very close (off 3lb higher) in this race last year, albeit was in better form at the time; admittedly may prove resurgent with Brighton reappearance under his belt.
runners.comment: All wins over 6f but went close (off 3lb higher) in this race last year

runners.name: Stacey Racey
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly on AW but ran well (close fifth off 4lb higher) in this contest 12 months ago and that form puts her in the picture; possibly needed latest run (back from a break).
runners.comment: Campaigned mostly on AW but ran well (close fifth) in this contest 12 months ago

runners.name: Call Glory
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner who is only 1-22 on turf but has been placed a few times since returned to this sphere, runner-up at Leicester most recently; fighting chance off current mark in this field.
runners.comment: Only 1-22 on turf but holds a fighting chance off current mark in this field

runners.name: Beau Jardine
runners.spotlight: Scored at Lingfield in most recent turf start; record at Salisbury features two wins (2023/2024) and a close fourth in this contest 12 months ago; again has frame possibilities.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in most recent turf start; close fourth in this contest 12 months ago

runners.name: Snooker McCrew
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner in 2024 for previous yard; missed 2025 and trailed home last of five at Salisbury (6f) ten days ago on reappearance; still has broadly poor form on turf.
runners.comment: AW winner in 2024; last of five at Salisbury on belated return to action

runners.name: Happier
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly at sprint distances; scored three times for previous yard but has inconsistent results for current stable; something to prove back over 7f.
runners.comment: Campaigned mostly at sprint trips; something to prove back over 7f

runners.name: Shades Of May
runners.spotlight: Maiden prior to building up a good strike-rate (3-6) on AW this year; however, disappointing when favourite last time and has something to prove back on turf.
runners.comment: Good strike-rate on AW this year but was disappointing last time

runners.name: Miraflores
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent maiden who has raced mostly on AW; posted one of her better efforts last time; no certainty to back up that form, especially returned to turf.
runners.comment: Inconsistent maiden who has raced mostly on AW; not solid

runners.name: Amathus
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent this season but posted one of his better efforts last time; dual winner at Salisbury, including narrowly under Freddy Tett in this race last year; respected off a workable mark.
runners.comment: Dual winner at Salisbury, including narrowly under Freddy Tett in this race last year

races.race_name: Kinross British EBF Novice Stakes (Colts & Geldings) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Soldier Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Justified market support with neck success at Ffos Las (6f, good) to contribute to his stable's excellent strike-rate (5-9) with 2yos on turf this term; the clear pick of the runners with experience and represents last year's winning connections.
runners.comment: Justified market support at Ffos Las; the clear pick of the runners with experience

runners.name: Gentle Hurricane
runners.spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; by Invincible Spirit; sibling to four winners, notably Light Blush (Listed-placed 7f; 96) and Happy Hadeda (6f AW 2yo; RPR 75); dam 1m2f winner (including Listed; 105); one of three newcomers who add interest to this race.
runners.comment: 105,000euros yearling; one of three newcomers who add interest to this race

runners.name: High Tower
runners.spotlight: 55,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; by Havana Grey; sibling to two winners, notably Star Of Lady M (prolific 5f-6f including 2yo/Listed; RPR 108); dam 7f AW winner (80), from family of top-class 1m2f-1m4f performer Fantastic Light; yard's 2yo strike-rate this season bodes well; respected debutant.
runners.comment: 55,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; yard's 2yo strike-rate this season bodes well; respected

runners.name: Yellow Mission
runners.spotlight: 36,000euros foal, 40,000gns yearling; by Space Blues and first foal of 1m6f Flat (RPR 72) and 2m/2m1f hurdle winner and daughter of Italian 1m2f Group 1 winner; owner is also represented by form pick Soldier Of The Sea; heed the market signals.
runners.comment: 40,000gns yearling; owner is also represented by form pick Soldier Of The Sea

runners.name: Hackpen Hill
runners.spotlight: Always towards the rear in 6f contest at Newbury where he was a 40-1 shot; perhaps one for handicaps later on.
runners.comment: Always towards the rear in 6f contest at Newbury

runners.name: Bollengo Boy
runners.spotlight: Bred to be useful but needs improvement on his Windsor efforts and looks likely to be more interesting in nurseries shortly.
runners.comment: Bred to be useful but needs improvement on his Windsor efforts

races.race_name: Seamus Mullins Racing / Roger Jowett Memorial British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive)

runners.name: Topaz
runners.spotlight: Met a spot of trouble on her way to finishing in the back half of big field at Royal Ascot; that effort is flanked by second-place finishes, latest at Newbury (6f, good to firm); leading contender at the weights.
runners.comment: Royal Ascot defeat is flanked by second-place finishes; leading contender at the weights

runners.name: Lola De Valence
runners.spotlight: Havana Grey half-sister to two 7f winners, notably Back In Black (including 2yo; RPR 101); dam 7f 2yo winner (78), out of 6f 2yo winner; one of three newcomers in the field; check the betting.
runners.comment: Havana Grey filly; one of three newcomers in the field; check the betting

runners.name: Silver Sovereign
runners.spotlight: Debutante by Ten Sovereigns and first foal of once-raced half-sister to 7f Group 3 winners Dancing Star and Foxtrot Lady and granddaughter of Nunthorpe winner Lochangel; notable connections; interesting.
runners.comment: Debutante by Ten Sovereigns and from a useful family; notable connections; interesting

runners.name: Golden Caturra
runners.spotlight: 11,000gns foal, 25,000euros yearling, 2,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; Caturra half-sister to three winners, notably Lightning Leo (7f 2yo; RPR 83); dam 1m4f/12.5f winner (91); yard has a poor strike-rate with 2yos.
runners.comment: 2,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; yard has a poor strike-rate with 2yos

runners.name: Happy Enough
runners.spotlight: Finished last of seven, about 12l behind Topaz, in 6f contest at Newmarket; may improve with the outing under her belt but has a lot to find in the rematch with that opponent.
runners.comment: About 12l behind Topaz in Newmarket contest but may do better
runners.owner: Whitsbury Manor Stud And Mrs M E Slade

races.race_name: Highclere Castle Gin Handicap

runners.name: Allegresse
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 0-5 on turf, compared to 2-2 on AW, and isn't particularly solid on his form in this sphere (possibly flattered by best RPR); however, this combination of drop back in trip/class and first-time headgear may have a positive effect.
runners.comment: 0-5 on turf but may benefit from this drop back in trip/class and fitting of headgear

runners.name: Blue Prince
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Salisbury (7f, good) on penultimate start and consistent otherwise this season; creditable third at Kempton (1m, AW) last time; still well treated on peak form, which includes a win off 4lb higher at Glorious Goodwood two years ago; solid.
runners.comment: Won at Salisbury on penultimate start and consistent otherwise this season; solid

runners.name: Celeborn
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who won at Epsom in sole outing last term; no further progress this season but retains ability and ran creditably in second-time cheekpieces at Ayr most recently; possibilities, provided the switch to blinkers has a bigger effect.
runners.comment: Possibilities, provided the switch to blinkers (from cheekpieces) has a bigger effect
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Arctic Thunder
runners.spotlight: Usually held up in rear; hasn't won since his 2yo days but has slipped to an attractive mark and could pop up when the cards drop right, which admittedly isn't guaranteed in this small-field scenario; less exposed at 1m than over shorter.
runners.comment: Has slipped to an attractive mark and could pop up when the cards drop right

races.race_name: Highclere Castle "The Perfect Gin" Handicap

runners.name: Dottie Diamond
runners.spotlight: Missed last season but has come back an improved filly and now bids for a 5f hat-trick after classifed/handicap wins, latest at Leicester (good to firm) seven days ago when beating Dreambird Dolly by just over 1l; respected under 5lb penalty with further progress possible.
runners.comment: An improved filly since returning to action and now bids for a hat-trick; respected

runners.name: Little Miss Magic
runners.spotlight: Back in much better form, having won a Lingfield classified event (6f, good) in clearcut fashion last month then finished a neck second in Bath handicap (5f, firm) last week; enters calculations despite still having a modest strike-rate.
runners.comment: Close second at Bath last week, confirming that she's back in much better form

runners.name: Follow My Heart
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; has made the frame in three of her four starts since running in Class 6 races, latest a Leicester classified (6f) seven days ago; possibilities, provided she shows some progress with Oisin Murphy up for the first time.
runners.comment: Encouraging form since running in Class 6 races; Oisin Murphy is up for first time

runners.name: Mademoiselle Belle
runners.spotlight: Registered sole success in AW contest in February; returned to turf with a creditable effort but subsequent form is inconsistent; never figured on debut for new yard last time.
runners.comment: AW winner who has proved inconsistent since returned to turf

runners.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners.spotlight: Has a record of 2102 since wearing blinkers, the success in Leicester classified contest (maiden previously); just over 1l behind Dottie Diamond there last Tuesday and now gets a 5lb pull with that opponent, who admittedly is open to further improvement; important contender.
runners.comment: Record of 2102 since wearing blinkers; ties in with Dottie Diamond on latest effort
runners.owner: T Beeches, C Stone, J Gallagher

runners.name: Cabeza De Llave
runners.spotlight: Placed plenty of times since last success and current mark is attractive; well capable of taking a serious hand but his losing run is mounting up and latest effort wasn't one of his best.
runners.comment: Losing run is mounting up and latest effort wasn't one of his best

runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: Holds weak claims on 2026 turf form and it remains a long time since his sole success.
runners.comment: Holds weak claims on 2026 turf form

runners.name: Reporter
runners.spotlight: Gained sole success off a higher mark but isn't particularly solid on 2026 efforts, both in the spring; left Michael Attwater since; possibly best watched unless the betting speaks positively.
runners.comment: Not particularly solid on 2026 efforts; both in the spring; debut for new yard

runners.name: Roman Spring
runners.spotlight: Has lacked consistency this term and failed to beat a rival last time, while also failing to back up his penultimate effort; yet to win away from Brighton on turf.
runners.comment: Has lacked consistency this term; yet to win away from Brighton on turf

races.race_name: Nationwide Concreting Handicap

runners.name: Curran
runners.spotlight: Not particularly consistent this term for new stable but his most recent Class 5 attempt resulted in Bath win (1m6f, good; narrowly off 1lb lower) in June; possibilities returned to this grade.
runners.comment: Most recent Class 5 attempt resulted in Bath win (off 1lb lower) in June; possibilities

runners.name: Blue Siam
runners.spotlight: Maiden on Flat and over hurdles; not wholly disgraced at Bath (1m6f) last week when returned to this sphere but finished only a modest third of five and best form remains on AW.
runners.comment: Maiden; modest third at Bath last week when returned to the Flat; best form is on AW

runners.name: Fair Dinkum
runners.spotlight: Gained his most recent success in C&D event (good) last October; best effort this term when going close at Salisbury (1m4f) on penultimate start; not disgraced in higher grade here latest; fighting chance returned to Class 5 and back up in trip.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last October; went close at Salisbury on penultimate start; fighting chance

runners.name: Masterdream
runners.spotlight: Has done most of his winning over jumps and gained his only Flat success three years ago; placed in ordinary handicap hurdle last time; returns to this code for first time since last autumn.
runners.comment: Has done most of his winning over jumps; gained only Flat success three years ago

races.race_name: Get Raceday Ready Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Three Yorkshiremen
runners.spotlight: Hit with a sharp rise in the weights after running away with a 0-55 here last backend and has struggled since, including in one go over this far; has moved yards yet again (new trainer also runs Shopaholic) which needs to have helped.
runners.comment: Ran away with a 0-55 here last backend; struggled since and has moved yards yet again

runners.name: Beaune
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m4f winner here in April, latterly off a 2lb lower mark; back in form without the usual cheekpieces (on again tonight) on turf last time and won't mind being back on Tapeta; goes on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Dual 1m4f winner here in April, latterly off a 2lb lower mark; goes on the shortlist

runners.name: The Pug
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner who's been this far only once, when not seeing it out; pulled hard for his new yard when third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) last month, then clipped heels and unseated early 11 days later; needs to settle better.
runners.comment: Infrequent winner who's been this far only once; needs to settle better

runners.name: Hill Station
runners.spotlight: Long time since he won on the Flat and he had lost his way when last seen; the change of yard will need to spark a revival and there's nothing to suggest he's best caught fresh.
runners.comment: Change of yard will need to spark a revival; nothing to suggest he's best caught fresh

runners.name: Daaris
runners.spotlight: Three wins and two seconds to his name from ten runs over C&D but he's struggled this year; absent for ten weeks since hanging right on the home turn over C&D and others make more obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Three wins and two seconds to his name from ten runs over C&D; struggled this year though

runners.name: Zaraquelle
runners.spotlight: Strong in the market on her first run in almost a year when third at Yarmouth a fortnight ago; comfortably held that day in a race than didn't pan out her way and she is entitled to improve, but has stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Entitled to improve for her comeback from almost a year off, but has stamina to prove

runners.name: Into Combat
runners.spotlight: Dam was a miler and he's not bred for this sort of trip; performed below market expectations all four runs since handicapping and, while his trainer-jockey combination will draw some in, stamina is an obvious concern.
runners.comment: Below market expectations all four runs since handicapping and stamina is a concern

runners.name: One Million Dreams
runners.spotlight: His two turf wins last summer came off higher marks, including in an amateurs' handicap; moderate form this year and the blinkers, worn once before when pulled up over fences, are given another try.
runners.comment: Moderate form this year and blinkers are given a second try

runners.name: Shopaholic
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in three runs over 1m2f to date; possible she'll improve for the new trip but she'll have to off this opening mark; jockey rode his first Flat winner early in the month (had two over hurdles as well); market useful.
runners.comment: Possible she'll improve for the new trip but she'll have to off this opening mark

runners.name: Fighting Poet
runners.spotlight: His three wins have come at Brighton and he has a patchy record on Tapeta; has been running poorly and doesn't make much appeal.
runners.comment: Has a patchy record on Tapeta; has been running poorly and doesn't make much appeal

runners.name: Freewheelin
runners.spotlight: Blew the start before finishing a remote last on his comeback two months ago; will need a big step forward.
runners.comment: Blew the start before finishing a remote last on his comeback two months ago

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners.name: Distinction
runners.spotlight: This has always been his time of year and he's a dual C&D winner who's back on a handy mark; it wouldn't be a shock if he popped up.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner who's back on a handy mark; it wouldn't be a shock if he popped up

runners.name: Dark Rosa
runners.spotlight: Sole handicap win came off this mark, the only time she's run on Tapeta, here (8.7f) last November; offered more on turf last time and she's one to consider back on the AW.
runners.comment: Sole handicap win came off this mark here, the only time she's run on Tapeta; considered

runners.name: Pulsar Star
runners.spotlight: He was back up to 1m (turf) when a well-backed favourite last time, but looked to have no excuses in finishing last of six; trainer has won with three of his last five runners, two at big prices, but this gelding has stamina to prove over this far.
runners.comment: Well-backed favourite last time but looked to have no excuses; has stamina to prove

runners.name: Imola
runners.spotlight: Now 2-3 over C&D having blown the start and hit a bit of traffic a fortnight ago; also had excuses here previously and she'd been consistent prior to that, but she has to prove this mark is within range.
runners.comment: 2-3 over C&D; excuses last time but has to prove this mark is within range

runners.name: Bellasio
runners.spotlight: Dual Carlisle winner who's recorded his best efforts on turf; showed the right attitude off 2lb lower last time but will need to at least match that form in this competitive handicap.
runners.comment: Returned all his best efforts on turf; showed the right attitude off 2lb lower last time

runners.name: Concert Boy
runners.spotlight: Very rarely goes this far and it's a long time since he won at higher than 0-55 level; always a chance he'll miss the break too and he's some way down the pecking order.
runners.comment: Very rarely goes this far and it's a long time since he won at higher than 0-55 level
runners.owner: Making Headway Racing And K Scott

runners.name: American State
runners.spotlight: Dual winner at around 1m early in the year, latterly off 1lb lower, who's been this far only once (C&D last backend), when well held; offered more last time but stamina remains a worry.
runners.comment: Dual winner at around 1m early in the year; offered more last time but stamina is a worry

runners.name: Kaaranah
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-3 over C&D when winning off a 3lb lower mark five weeks ago (ridden from off the pace by Jack Callan that night and may be again from stall 13); stable flying this month, with seven winners from its last 15 runners at the start of the day, and he holds good claims.
runners.comment: Made it 3-3 over C&D when winning off a 3lb lower mark five weeks ago; shortlisted

runners.name: Symphony Of Joy
runners.spotlight: Struggled since handicapping this year and he blew the start at Wetherby last month before pulling too hard on Tapeta a fortnight ago; goes beyond 1m for the first time and will need to settle better upped from 7f.
runners.comment: Struggled since handicapping; goes beyond 1m for the first time and will need to settle

runners.name: No Knee Never
runners.spotlight: Held off his revised mark on turf since two AW wins, including here, in April; wins have all come over shorter but he stays this far and is one to consider back on Tapeta.
runners.comment: Wins all came over shorter but he stays this far and is one to consider back on Tapeta

runners.name: Caledonian
runners.spotlight: Won a Tapeta nursery the only time he's run on the AW; the change of surface is the main hope, with him having struggled in three turf runs since coming back from nine months off.
runners.comment: Won a Tapeta nursery the only time he's run on the AW; struggled this season

runners.name: Eagle Day
runners.spotlight: Five-time course winner who failed to enhance a good record for Rossa Ryan when fluffing the start here a fortnight ago; has a competitive mark, though, and holds each-way claims under Pat Cosgrave.
runners.comment: Five-time course winner; has a competitive mark now and holds each-way claims

runners.name: Look Back Smiling
runners.spotlight: Better with each of his three runs for this yard and wasn't beaten far at Kempton a fortnight ago, despite hanging right; stays this far and is quite happy on Tapeta, so he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Better with each of his three runs for this yard; quite happy on Tapeta; one to consider

races.race_name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C-D) (GBB)

runners.name: Jazzy Blue
runners.spotlight: Best of three runs on turf when second of nine at Leicester (7f, good) last month, but has since finished just under 2l behind Consultation when fifth of 13 at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm); each-way claims.
runners.comment: Second at Leicester but then nearly 2l behind Consultation at Yarmouth; each-way claims

runners.name: Serenity Bay
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in her first two starts at Windsor (6f, good) and Brighton (7f, good to firm); breeding suggests that middle-distance handicaps will be her thing in due course.
runners.comment: Well beaten in both starts; breeding suggests middle-distance handicaps will be her thing

runners.name: Syndicale
runners.spotlight: February foal by Ten Sovereigns; half-sister to winners Ombudsman (1m-10.3f including four Group 1s; RPR 133), Synchronicity (7f; 89) and American Belle (7f including AW; 83); dam 7f AW 2yo/1m2f turf winner (79), sister to 1m Group 3 winner Runnymede; stable's 2yo newcomers are always worth the closest scrutiny, while both her breeding and an entry in the Group 1 Moyglare Stud Stakes make her even more so.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Ombudsman and holds a Group 1 entry; worth the closest scrutiny

runners.name: Perfect Love
runners.spotlight: March foal by Palace Pier; 30,000gns yearling; closely related to US 1m/8.5f turf winner Principled Stand, half-sister to winners Forever Blue (6f 2yo/7f; RPR 90) and Savrola (1m-2m including AW; 85); dam 1m 2yo/11.6f Listed winner (RPR 97), half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner; stable only has the occasion winning 2yo newcomer; market informative.
runners.comment: Stable only has the occasion winning 2yo newcomer; market informative

runners.name: Musical Force
runners.spotlight: 22-1 when only beating one home on her Yarmouth debut (6f, good to firm) last month; closely related to several AW winners and is open to improvement, but it will very much be needed.
runners.comment: Only beat one home on her Yarmouth debut; open to improvement, but it will be needed

runners.name: Peacock's Way
runners.spotlight: March foal by Starman; 60,000euros yearling; 18,000gns breeze-up 2yo; dam unraced sister to useful 5f-7f winner Elegant Erin, out of maiden half-sister to useful 7f-10.6f winner Eaglemont; wouldn't be an obvious winner on debut, especially from the outside stall.
runners.comment: Wouldn't be an obvious winner on debut, especially from the outside stall
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Pride's Queen
runners.spotlight: Well held in turf maidens at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and Doncaster (7f, good to firm); tongue-tie is now given a go but she may be one for nurseries; stable also runs the newcomer Senorita Luna.
runners.comment: Well held in two turf maidens; may be one for nurseries; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Senorita Luna
runners.spotlight: April foal by Supremacy; 5,000euros yearling; half-sister to 7f 2yo-10.5f winner Dont Do Dramas (RPR 78); dam French 10.5f-1m4f winner (including AW), half-sister to 8.6f winner Prioritise, out of 6f 2yo winning close relative of 6f 2yo Group 1 winners Blue Duster and Zieten; stable won this with a newcomer last year; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Stable won this with a newcomer last year; worth a market check
runners.owner: Mohamed Rashid Hamdan Al Saadi & Partner

runners.name: Kiss Cam
runners.spotlight: Sent off 16-1 when last of 11 on her Newbury debut (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago, finishing just over 4l behind Miss You Nights; looks to need more time.
runners.comment: Last of 11 on her Newbury debut 12 days ago; looks to need more time

runners.name: Miss You Nights
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to six winners, but never figured when eighth of 11 on her Newbury debut (6f, good to firm; 18-1) 12 days ago; related to AW winners, but improvement needed.
runners.comment: Never figured on her Newbury debut 12 days ago; improvement needed

races.race_name: Book To Stay - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Athenian Spirit
runners.spotlight: 0-11 for William Knight but placed on five occasions, two of them over C&D; changed hands for 10,000gns earlier this month; each-way shout
runners.comment: 0-11 for W Knight but placed five times, including C&D; sold 10,000gns since latest run

runners.name: Hakin Adraar
runners.spotlight: He has shown promise on AW, including a fourth of 13 on his stable debut in May, and two defeats on turf since are probably not the races to judge him on; still has potential on this surface.
runners.comment: Seems a better horse on AW and still has potential on this surface; one to consider

runners.name: Distillation
runners.spotlight: Two respectable efforts in handicaps last month, including C&D, without suggesting he was ahead of his mark.
runners.comment: Two respectable handicap runs last month without suggesting he was ahead of his mark

runners.name: Torbados
runners.spotlight: Ran right up to his best when fourth of 13 at Kempton (1m) two weeks ago; draw could have been kinder but he could have more to offer in blinkers.
runners.comment: Fair fourth at Kempton last time; draw could have been kinder but not a forlorn hope

runners.name: Grand Vista
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for third, beaten under one length, at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) 13 days ago; didn't look entirely straightforward but he holds each-way claims.
runners.comment: Not beaten far into 3rd at Chepstow 13 days ago; needs more to win but it's not impossible

runners.name: Personal Pride
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in his maiden runs, including C&D, but he has suffered two heavy defeats in handicaps; dropped 5lb but carries risk.
runners.comment: Promise in maidens but he has suffered two heavy defeats in handicaps; risky

runners.name: Pennine Way
runners.spotlight: Prominent in the betting for her two handicap runs last month but there has been no immediate improvement; bred to be useful though and she still has time on her side.
runners.comment: No improvement for handicaps as yet but she's well bred and still has time to do better

runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Two wins on Lingfield's AW track this year (6f/5f) and on the same mark as for the second of them; stamina for 7f has to be confirmed.
runners.comment: Two sprint wins at Lingfield (AW) this season; stamina for 7f a major query

runners.name: The Floors Munky
runners.spotlight: Poor form over a variety of trips; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Poor form over a variety of trips; hard to recommend

runners.name: Captive Beauty
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two Irish runs and again when 100-1 for her stable debut here last month (ridden by a 7lb claimer); this is more realistic and she needs a market check.
runners.comment: Modest form thus far but rates a likely improver now handicapping; market check advised

races.race_name: Book To Stay - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Based
runners.spotlight: Most of his form has been modest but he has run twice over C&D, finishing second in April and winning last month; not so good at Newcastle last time but the return to Wolverhampton should give him a lift.
runners.comment: A win and a 2nd from two C&D runs; return to this venue could prompt another step forward

runners.name: Musical Soldier
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a C&D handicap in May off a 5lb lower mark; runner-up in three of his last four starts; usual tongue-tie dispensed with but cheekpieces are given a go.
runners.comment: C&D winner; second in three of his last four starts; tongue-tie off and cheekpieces on

runners.name: Crown The Future
runners.spotlight: Won a weak C&D nursery for Jack Morland last November; beaten at short odds on his next three starts and he has been well held in two runs for Tony Carroll; too much to prove for comfort.
runners.comment: Won a weak C&D nursery for J Morland last November; well held for new yard

runners.name: Electrocution
runners.spotlight: C&D win in February came off a 1lb higher mark; not at his best on his last four starts and others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 1lb higher mark in February; not at his best on last four starts; opposable

runners.name: Oh So Perfect
