runners.spotlight: On the up when last seen, getting off the mark at Chelmsford (7f) in February and following up over the same C&D one month later; well drawn for a front-runner but she will need to be at her best back from 131 days off.
runners.comment: Back-to-back 7f wins at Chelmsford earlier in the year; well drawn to attack; contender

runners.name: Dusk Damsel
runners.spotlight: Finished second of ten on her handicap debut at Lingfield (6f, AW) in April; not so good twice since, including when over 5l behind Based here seven weeks ago.
runners.comment: Second at Lingfield (6f, AW) in April but less good since, including behind Based latest
runners.owner: Ms H N Pinniger And Partner

runners.name: Magic Lady Mae
runners.spotlight: Ran a fair race on her seasonal debut at Chelmsford in March (7f) but no progress since, including when well beaten in one run for the Frosts last month; too much to prove starting out for another yard.
runners.comment: One run that brings her into the reckoning but opposable on balance
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Ten Cuidado
runners.spotlight: His only effort of note from five attempts came over C&D; still not easily recommended after a heavy defeat at Kempton two weeks ago; headgear now tried.
runners.comment: His best effort came over C&D but he is far from a solid option; headgear now tried

runners.name: Fullstop
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer; third of 17 at Leicester (7f, good) in April represented improvement but it hasn't been a catalyst for better things; widest draw not ideal either.
runners.comment: Good 3rd at Leicester in April but no progress since; widest stall to overcome too

runners.name: Neat And Tidy
runners.spotlight: Some promise on her racecourse debut last September (only run for the Muir/Grassick stable) but well beaten in three AW runs for Jonathan Portman over the winter; not a solid option starting out for another new stable after 165 days off, but worth a market check all the same.
runners.comment: Not built on debut promise; worth a market check starting out for another new yard

races.race_name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Maiden Handicap

runners.name: Case Study
runners.spotlight: Good second at Lingfield (1m, AW; cheekpiecees first time) on her second handicap run; lacklustre effort at Redcar (7f, good) last time; steps back up in trip with new headgear tried.
runners.comment: Penultimate run brings her into it but she ran poorly on turf latest; new headgear today

runners.name: Blue Celestial
runners.spotlight: Placed in five of her ten runs but she is not progressing; more minor money perhaps her best hope.
runners.comment: Often placed but she is not progressing; may have to make do with more minor money

runners.name: Positive Thoughts
runners.spotlight: Promise as a 2yo and she ran her best race in handicaps when keeping on for third at Hamilton (8.3f, good) ten days ago; her best run came on Tapeta and she is one to consider.
runners.comment: Ran her best race in handicaps when third at Hamilton ten days ago; handles AW; chance

runners.name: Seconds Count
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; fair form in her two C&D runs this summer but likely vulnerable to a less-exposed 3yo.
runners.comment: Fair form over C&D twice this summer but vulnerable to the less-exposed 3yos

runners.name: Sunshine And Roses
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden who has been short of her 2yo best in two runs this year; conditions no problem but others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; not shone so far this year and likely vulnerable again

runners.name: Ernie McCrew
runners.spotlight: Late headway into fourth at Lingfield two weeks ago (1m, AW) but he was still beaten 7l at the finish; improvement essential.
runners.comment: Late headway into 4th last time but still beaten 7l at the finish; improvement essential

runners.name: Esdaile
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held in three runs in fillies' novice/maiden races last month; should be capable of better now handicapping; AW debut.
runners.comment: Modest form in three runs last month; potential improver now handicapping on AW debut

runners.name: Ocean Force
runners.spotlight: Poor form in four runs in maiden/novice company (6f-1m) but he has left the distinct impression that he is capable of better; steps back up in trip for his handicap debut and market support would look significant.
runners.comment: Has left the distinct impression he's capable of better; market to guide on handicap debut

runners.name: Iconic Dawn
runners.spotlight: Some promise over 6f as a 2yo but her two handicap runs have been poor; stepping up in trip needs to have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two handicap runs; hopes rest on the step up in trip sparking extra

runners.name: Starborn
runners.spotlight: Modest form in her three qualifying runs (6f-7f); encouragement for this longer trip on pedigree and she's one to note for market confidence.
runners.comment: Steps up in trip for her handicap debut; needs more but it is not out of the question

runners.name: Cy Twombly
runners.spotlight: Some promise for the Crisfords in 2024 but absent for 402 days prior to his stable debut; he has not shown enough in his four runs since December to be of major interest.
runners.comment: Struggled for new yard after a 402-day absence; easy enough to swerve

races.race_name: Call 01902 390016 To Name A Race Handicap

runners.name: Master Dandy
runners.spotlight: Was back off his last winning mark when beaten a head and a nose into third of 12 over C&D last month (second and fourth have won since); up 1lb and drawn wider this time, but still one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Narrowly beaten into third of 12 over C&D last month; one for the shortlist

runners.name: Watermelon Sugar
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who hasn't shown much lately, but is back off the same mark as when successful at Lingfield (6f, Polytrack) in February and is better drawn than he was back here last time; worth a second look, especially if backed.
runners.comment: C&D winner and back off last winning mark; worth a second look, especially if backed

runners.name: Massimo Blue
runners.spotlight: Ran a blinder from the outside stall when beaten a short head and a neck into third of 11 at Kempton (6f, Polytrack; first-time cheekpieces) 19 days ago; has winning form on Tapeta and respected back down to Class 6.
runners.comment: Ran well when a close third at Kempton last time; respected back down to Class 6

runners.name: Auntie Jo
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) for David O'Meara this year; not beaten far into third of ten on her second start for this yard at Musselburgh (5f, good) three weeks ago, but a suspicion that the minimum trip suits her best.
runners.comment: Not beaten far into third at Musselburgh last time, but 5f may suit her best
runners.owner: Making Headway Racing And K Scott

runners.name: White Umbrella
runners.spotlight: Not at her best lately but has become dangerously well handicapped, 7lb lower than when winning for the third time over C&D just over a year ago; ran with credit on a couple of occasions back here in the spring and may be worth chancing in the returning blinkers.
runners.comment: Triple C&D winner who has become dangerously well handicapped, 7lb below last winning mark

runners.name: Crystal Dagger
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden who finished runner-up in four of her eight starts for Ed Walker, but she hasn't matched that form in four outings for this yard; best efforts have come at 7f.
runners.comment: 0-12; below form in four outings for this yard; best efforts have come at 7f

runners.name: Brave Empire
runners.spotlight: Ran well when a close fourth of 16 at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last month, but didn't back it up at Pontefract (5f, good; first-time hood) a fortnight ago; opposable given his wide draw and a losing run of 22.
runners.comment: Inconsistent of late and opposable given his wide draw and a losing run of 22

runners.name: Candy Warhol
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who doesn't have the best strike-rate (3-48), but he is consistent and again ran well when fourth of 11 from the outside stall over C&D 15 days ago; may not face too much competition for the lead and could go well again.
runners.comment: Not a great strike-rate but he is consistent; may not face much competition for the lead
runners.owner: Homecroft Wealth, Paul J Dixon & Partners

runners.name: Blue Lancero
runners.spotlight: Well held in all four starts and, after being gelded, has failed to beat a rival in two outings on the AW for this yard; needs a transformation.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a rival in two outings on the AW for this yard; needs a transformation

runners.name: Landlordtothestars
runners.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when winning over 7f here in September; has won fresh so the four-month absence not a major problem, but he has never tackled a trip this short before; blinkers are given a go.
runners.comment: Back off last winning mark, but has never tackled a trip this short before; blinkers on

runners.name: Never Dark
runners.spotlight: Winner of nine races, all over 5f including two here, but has dropped 18lb below his last winning mark for a reason; didn't show enough on his recent return from nine months off to make him of immediate interest.
runners.comment: Didn't show enough on recent return from nine months off to make him of immediate interest
